hero.heading: Crafted by Nature,
hero.description: We don't just process materials. We document the transformation of raw coconut husk into the world's most sustainable architectural fiber.

mission.title: The Mission
mission.description: To bridge the gap between industrial necessity and ecological integrity. We repurpose agricultural waste into high-performance materials that give back to the soil from which they came.

vision.title: The Vision
vision.description: A world where every structure is supported by the living loom of nature. We strive to be the global standard for carbon-negative architectural substrates by 2030.

founder.label: The Hands Behind the Fiber
founder.heading: A Legacy Rooted in the Soil.
founder.description: Founder Elara Vance spent two decades in the coastal plantations of Kerala, witnessing the untapped potential of the coconut husk. What others saw as waste, Elara saw as a structural miracle.
founder.quote: Sustainability isn't a feature; it's the fundamental architecture of everything we build.

milestones.heading: Our Growth Rings
milestones.description: Like the palms we harvest from, our journey is marked by steady, organic growth.

items.title: The Seedling (2012)
items.description: First extraction facility established in the coastal belts, focusing on raw fiber purity and local artisan partnership.

items.title: The Synthesis (2018)
items.description: Developed our proprietary organic binding synthesis, allowing coir to be used in high-load architectural panels.

items.title: Global Canopy (2024)
items.description: Opening our flagship sustainable lab in Zurich, bringing tropical engineering to the heart of European design.
